scope: Initial geographic and authored-export capability estimates. Trees and resources now carry a place-evidence candidate model; the export plan's tree budget and balanced ore/oil top-up stay separate. Not a digital twin of the simulation. Real-connections generation remains opt-in; the public writer still uses template corridors.

promise_levels.promised: The stated capability has relevant native evidence bound to this exact export and test conditions. Never inferred from stock-map ranks, metadata counts or geographic similarity.
promise_levels.likely: The deterministic model found a candidate. Game behavior or simulation stability remains unverified for this export.
promise_levels.not_possible_here: The current export plan lacks this capability under the stated rule. Not a claim that no other generator or human map-maker could provide it.
promise_levels.unknown: Inputs, a model or relevant game observations are missing. Absence of evidence is not a negative result.

ship.limits: Four-connected block-min depth grid with one-cell shore clearance; a component must reach the central 25 tiles and two separated edge points. Bounds are modelling choices, not measured game limits. The existing ship generator can smooth a path outside this corridor; an authored route still needs its own check.

place.scope: Vegetation suitability and recorded resource evidence on the pan-time 271-node (64 m) lattice, central 25 tiles. Not the export's planted tree budget and not its balanced ore/oil top-up.
place.landcover_source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m, CC-BY 4.0, the same document tools/map-factory/landcover.py reads
place.deposit_source: USGS MRDS through tools/map-factory/evidence.py; capability-evidence.js uses the same MRDS query as mapgen.js, without the exporter's MSHA/NETL sources

fidelity.pan_time: WorldCover overview nearest the 64 m lattice, bounded to 262144 pixels per tile, sampled at the same 271 nodes as the depth grid; capture-time terrain screens slope.
fidelity.prepared: The writer's own 1728-square 10 m WorldCover grid sampled at the same 271 nodes; prepared terrain screens slope. Patch coherence and the tree budget stay in the export plan.

limits: Land cover says what a place can host. It is not the exported plan's tree count or resource bytes.
Balanced ore/oil top-ups fill each export to stock shares; they are not place evidence and never count here.
A missing deposit record is not geographic absence: MRDS has worldwide legacy records with a U.S. focus and uneven completeness/currency; MSHA/NETL are exporter-only.
The slope screen uses capture or prepared terrain at 64 m; the writer grades trees at 16 m, so steep small features read flatter here.
Thresholds are candidate levels awaiting game observation, not native constants.

stock_reference.excluded: CO.crp: blank editor terrain system package
stock_reference.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; bands strictly below p25, inclusive typical, strictly above p75. Descriptive, not quality gates.

wet_central_fraction.name: Wet share of the central 25 tiles

terrain_relief_m.name: Terrain relief across the whole map

fertile_land_suitability.name: Fertile land suitability
